summary: Magna International filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 5, 2026 press release announcing TSX acceptance of its notice to renew a normal course issuer bid (the Canadian equivalent of an issuer share repurchase program) plus an automatic share purchase plan. The NCIB authorizes discretionary repurchases of up to 25,778,000 common shares, about 10% of the 257,862,127-share public float against 258,383,499 shares outstanding as of October 31, 2026. It runs November 9, 2026 to November 8, 2027, with purchases for cancellation and to fund stock-based compensation; no price or premium is stated. Watch actual buyback pace as a signal on management's valuation view.
